content.text:
I've replaced the hand-built (i) in Memory.tsx with the shared `InfoButton`, but I couldn't run any tests or the typecheck because Bash was denied. To keep the phone's (i) in place, I also had to change three files the order didn't name.

**`src/screens/Memory.tsx`**
- It now imports `InfoButton` instead of `InfoSheet`. The unused `InfoIcon` import is gone.
- I removed the `info`/`setInfo` state, the hand-built `<button>`, the `<InfoSheet …/>` element and the `onInfo: () => setInfo(true)` handler.
- `infoButton` is now one element: `<InfoButton title={T.net.page.infoTitle} sentences={infoSentences(…)} testId="memory-info" />`. It still appears in the same three places: the bar on a wide window, beside the search in the phone's list view, and after the map's line in the phone's net view. Only one shows at a time.
- `InfoButton` builds its own `aria-label` from the de.ts text map (`T.info.open(title)`) and sets `aria-haspopup="dialog"`. So the accessible name ("Erklärung öffnen: Das Gedächtnis") and the test IDs `memory-info` and `memory-info-sheet` stay the same. The `memory-info` test ID follows the `<screen>-info` pattern the other `InfoButton`s use.
- **One gap against the acceptance criteria:** `aria-haspopup` and `aria-label` are set on the `<button>` that `InfoButton` renders, not passed as props on the `<InfoButton>` element in Memory.tsx. None of the other `InfoButton`s in the app pass them as props either, and the component has no such props. If the check needs those attributes written on the element itself, `InfoButton` would need new props.

**The extra files** (needed because `onInfo` was the only way the phone's net view opened the sheet; without them that (i) would have disappeared):
- **`src/screens/KnowledgeNet.tsx`**: the `onInfo?: () => void` prop is now `info?: ComponentChildren`, passed through to `NetHeader`.
- **`src/screens/net/NetHeader.tsx`**: it renders `info` inside `<span class="net__info">` instead of building its own button, and drops the `InfoIcon` import. The check that measures whether the line fits now counts that span as well as buttons.
- **`src/styles/knowledge-net.css`**: the old `.icon-button.net__info` rule is now `.net__info` (no shrinking, takes taps) plus `.net__info .icon-button` (the 44px target, negative margin and round shape), so the button looks and sizes as before.

No new files. A search confirms Memory.tsx no longer contains `onInfo`, `setInfo`, `InfoSheet` or `InfoIcon`.

**To check:** run `pnpm tsc --noEmit`, the unit tests, and the e2e specs `tests/e2e/memory-net-592.spec.ts` and `tests/e2e/quiet-app-566.spec.ts`. The first spec checks the phone (i)'s position and its 44px target after the map's line.
